_comment: GENERATED by camfrog-bot tools/build_owner_caps.py from Pepe's code - don't edit by hand.

capabilities.title: Run your room's stage
capabilities.howto: Type !stage in your Camfrog room to see what's on. Feature an open slot to make it the room's main stream (free), unfeature it, cut a slot (the unused PAT is refunded) or set how many user slots the room has. The same controls are on the Stage tab of your pad settings.

capabilities.title: Switch cam snapshots on or off
capabilities.howto: !snap lets people save a still of someone's cam (they pay the snap price). Type !snap off in your room to stop it there, or flip it on your owner page.

capabilities.title: Switch cam clips on or off
capabilities.howto: !clip records a few seconds of a cam to a link (and the website's 🎬 Clip). Switch it per room in chat or on your owner page.

capabilities.title: Pick Pepe's language in your room
capabilities.howto: Pepe follows the room's chat language by default (auto). Fix it to one language with !language es (or pick it on your owner page); !language auto goes back to following the chat.

capabilities.title: Switch mic challenges on or off
capabilities.howto: Mic challenges (sing, laugh, beatbox...) are judged by Pepe and paid from your room vault. Turn them off in your room with !challenge off, or on your owner page.

capabilities.title: Start, open and close mic challenges
capabilities.howto: As the owner you can start a challenge for someone (!challenge sing @bob), open a round anyone can enter (!challenge open sing 2m), close the round or cancel a challenge.

capabilities.title: Cancel someone's duel or brawl challenge
capabilities.howto: Anyone can cancel their own challenge; in your room you can also cancel other people's open duel or brawl challenges (their stakes are refunded).

capabilities.title: Get your vault deposits matched (launch pads)
capabilities.howto: While your pad is new (a launch pad), what you deposit into its room vault is matched from the launchpad budget up to its cap. Deposit with !roomvault deposit <amount> or the Top up form on your owner page.

capabilities.title: Change your room's Pepe settings from the website
capabilities.howto: Your owner page flips snapshots, clips, mic challenges and Pepe's language for your room - the same settings as the chat commands above, so chat and the page always agree.

capabilities.title: Connect your room to its pad page
capabilities.howto: Choose what your pad's web page carries from the Camfrog room: website chat lines, push-to-talk voice clips, cam snapshots, room audio and mic transcripts.

capabilities.title: Top up your room vault from the website
capabilities.howto: The Top up form on the owner page deposits PAT from your linked Camfrog name into the room vault (minimum 1,000). It's exactly !roomvault deposit: deposits never count as the room's income, and a double click is one deposit.
